text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, lansoprazole 30 mg capsules are not on FDA's drug shortage list. Corvale East holds 182 capsules (19 days on hand at 9.6/day). Corvale General holds 255 capsules (27.7 days on hand at 9.2/day). Corvale Lakeside holds 35 capsules (15.3 days on hand). The current product label names A-S Medication Solutions as the registered plant.

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage list does not include lansoprazole as of 2026-10-21. A-S Medication Solutions received a Warning Letter on 2017-06-05. Its most recent inspection was classified VAI on 2026-08-12. The top-ranked alternative supplier, Camber Pharmaceuticals, Inc., is not on FDA's shortage list and uses Hetero Labs Limited Unit III, last inspected VAI on 2023-07-21.

Our position: Current inventory covers immediate needs at East and General, but Lakeside supply is limited. The A-S Medication Solutions plant has a prior Warning Letter and a recent VAI classification. Camber offers a verified supply chain with a recent acceptable inspection. Other ranked alternatives lack identifiable plant information on their labels.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to place orders with Camber Pharmaceuticals, Inc. to replenish stock at all three sites; requires Pharmacy Director approval.
2. Buyer to verify Camber supply chain continuity and monitor FDA inspection records for Hetero Labs Limited Unit III; requires Pharmacy Director approval.
3. Buyer to monitor FDA regulatory actions for A-S Medication Solutions; requires Pharmacy Director approval.
4. Buyer to evaluate Ajanta Pharma USA Inc., Ascend Laboratories, LLC, BluePoint Laboratories, and Dr.Reddy's Laboratories Ltd. only if plant information becomes available; requires Pharmacy Director approval.

Not recommended: Switching to alternative suppliers without confirmed plant inspection history. Delaying Camber orders pending committee clinical review.
